name: vscode-mcp-dap-debugger
description: VS Code extension and CLI that expose VS Code's Debug Adapter Protocol as MCP tools for AI coding agents

vscodeDebugMcp.agentSkills.claude.enable.description: Write the DAP debugging skill guide for Claude Code (.claude/skills).

vscodeDebugMcp.agentSkills.claude.scope.description: Where to write the Claude Code skill: this workspace, your home directory (~/.claude), or both.

vscodeDebugMcp.agentSkills.claude.onlyIf.description: Only write the skill where a .claude folder already exists, instead of creating it from scratch.

vscodeDebugMcp.agentSkills.gemini.enable.description: Write the DAP debugging skill guide for Gemini CLI (.gemini/skills).

vscodeDebugMcp.agentSkills.gemini.scope.description: Where to write the Gemini CLI skill: this workspace, your home directory (~/.gemini), or both.

vscodeDebugMcp.agentSkills.gemini.onlyIf.description: Only write the skill where a .gemini folder already exists, instead of creating it from scratch.

vscodeDebugMcp.agentSkills.kilo.enabled.description: Write the DAP debugging skill guide for Kilo Code (.kilo/skills).

vscodeDebugMcp.agentSkills.kilo.scope.description: Where to write the Kilo Code skill: this workspace, your home directory (~/.kilo), or both.

vscodeDebugMcp.agentSkills.kilo.onlyIfAl.description: Only write the skill where a .kilo folder already exists, instead of creating it from scratch.

vscodeDebugMcp.agentSkills.agentsMd.enab.description: Add/update a clearly-marked section in AGENTS.md (read by Codex CLI and other tools) describing this tool's CLI. Never touches the rest of the file.

vscodeDebugMcp.agentSkills.agentsMd.only.description: Only update the marked section if AGENTS.md already exists in the workspace, instead of creating a new one.

vscodeDebugMcp.server.port.description: Preferred port for the local MCP server. If busy, the next free port is used automatically.

vscodeDebugMcp.server.autoStart.description: Start the MCP server automatically when a workspace is opened. Disable to start it manually via the "Debug MCP: Start MCP Server" command.

vscodeDebugMcp.server.dapLogCapacity.description: Max number of raw DAP protocol messages kept per debug session.

vscodeDebugMcp.server.consoleOutputCapac.description: Max number of debug console output lines kept per debug session.

vscodeDebugMcp.server.exceptionCapacity.description: Max number of exception records kept per debug session.

vscodeDebugMcp.server.terminatedSessionR.description: How long a terminated debug session's logs/console/exceptions stay readable before being discarded.

scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run lint
